title: Sitemap URL Extractor with Diff & llms.txt Check
description: Extract every URL from a website's XML sitemaps. Sitemaps are discovered via robots.txt and common paths; sitemap indexes and .gz files are followed. Optionally compare with your previous run to get added and removed URLs.

startUrls.title: Websites, sitemap URLs or robots.txt URLs
startUrls.description: One entry per line. Accepts a domain (example.com), a homepage URL, a robots.txt URL, a sitemap URL (.xml, .xml.gz, .txt) or an llms.txt URL. For a homepage or domain, the extractor finds sitemaps via robots.txt and common paths such as /sitemap.xml.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per website
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop after this many URL rows per website. Each URL row is billed as one url-extracted event, so this is also your cost cap per site.

discoverFromRobotsTxt.title: Discover sitemaps from robots.txt
discoverFromRobotsTxt.sectionDescription: How sitemaps are found when you enter a domain or homepage.

probeCommonPaths.title: Probe common sitemap paths
probeCommonPaths.description: If robots.txt lists no sitemap, try /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /sitemap-index.xml, /sitemap.xml.gz and /wp-sitemap.xml.

checkLlmsTxt.title: Check llms.txt and llms-full.txt
checkLlmsTxt.description: Record whether /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt exist, their size and how many links they contain. This check is free.

includeLlmsTxtUrls.title: Also output URLs listed in llms.txt
includeLlmsTxtUrls.description: Add each link found in llms.txt as a URL row (source = llms.txt). Billed like any other URL row.

maxSitemapFiles.title: Max sitemap files per website
maxSitemapFiles.description: Safety cap for very large sitemap indexes.

maxSitemapDepth.title: Max sitemap index depth
maxSitemapDepth.description: How many levels of nested sitemap indexes to follow.

includeUrlRegex.title: Include URLs matching (regex)
includeUrlRegex.description: Only keep URLs that match this JavaScript regular expression, for example /blog/. Filtered-out URLs are not billed.
includeUrlRegex.sectionDescription: Filtered-out URLs are never written to the dataset and never billed.

excludeUrlRegex.title: Exclude URLs matching (regex)
excludeUrlRegex.description: Drop URLs that match this JavaScript regular expression, for example \.(pdf|jpg)$.

lastmodFrom.title: Last modified on or after
lastmodFrom.description: Keep only URLs whose lastmod is on or after this date. Absolute (2026-09-01) or relative (7 days). URLs without lastmod are kept unless 'Drop URLs without lastmod' is on.

lastmodTo.title: Last modified on or before
lastmodTo.description: Keep only URLs whose lastmod is on or before this date.

dropUrlsWithoutLastmod.title: Drop URLs without lastmod when a date filter is set
dropUrlsWithoutLastmod.description: Only applies when a lastmod filter is set.

sameHostOnly.title: Keep only URLs on the same host
sameHostOnly.description: Drop sitemap entries that point to other hosts.

compareWithPreviousRun.title: Compare with previous run (added / removed URLs)
compareWithPreviousRun.description: Save a snapshot of each website's URL list in a named key-value store in your own Apify account and mark each URL as added or unchanged since the last snapshot. URLs that disappeared are added as rows with changeType = removed.
compareWithPreviousRun.sectionDescription: Snapshots are stored in your own account. Nobody else can read them.

stateStoreName.title: Snapshot store name
stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store (in your account) that keeps the snapshots. Use different names to keep separate histories.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: all = every current URL plus removed URLs. changesOnly = only added and removed URLs (requires 'Compare with previous run').

checkHttpStatus.title: Check HTTP status of each URL
checkHttpStatus.description: Send a lightweight HEAD request (GET if HEAD is not allowed) to each URL and record the status code and final URL. Billed as status-checked per URL. Slower; respects robots.txt and per-host rate limits.

statusCheckMaxUrls.title: Max URLs to status-check per website
statusCheckMaxUrls.description: Upper limit of URLs to status-check for each website. Only used when HTTP status check is on.

statusCheckConcurrencyPerHost.title: Parallel status checks per host
statusCheckConcurrencyPerHost.description: Kept low on purpose so target websites are not overloaded.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip sitemap files and status checks for paths disallowed by robots.txt.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each robots.txt, sitemap or llms.txt request.
